audience: site owners and developers adding the ten widgets to a Capell site
prerequisites: Layout Builder is installed. Running `composer require` only downloads the bundle and its ten widgets; they stay inactive until the bundle is installed in Capell.
task: Install **Widget Showcase**, or run `php artisan capell:extension-install capell-app/widget-showcase`, which also installs any of the ten widgets that are not installed yet.
expectedResult: All ten widgets are listed as installed and appear by name in the Layout Builder widget list.
nextStep: Open a page, click **Layout builder**, **Add widgets**, then choose a widget such as **Slideshow** or **Countdown**.
